title: Psalm 129
opening_line: Oft did they vex me from my youth,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Oft did they vex me from my youth,
text.normalized: Oft did they vex me from my youth,
text.reading: Oft did they vex me from my youth,

text.diplomatic: may Isr’el now declare;
text.normalized: May Isr’el now declare;
text.reading: may Isr’el now declare;

text.diplomatic: Oft did they vex me from my youth,
text.normalized: Oft did they vex me from my youth,
text.reading: Oft did they vex me from my youth,

text.diplomatic: yet not victorious were.
text.normalized: Yet not victorious were.
text.reading: yet not victorious were.

text.diplomatic: The ploughers ploughed upon my back;
text.normalized: The ploughers ploughed upon my back;
text.reading: The ploughers ploughed upon my back;

text.diplomatic: they long their furrows drew.
text.normalized: They long their furrows drew.
text.reading: they long their furrows drew.

text.diplomatic: The righteous LORD did cut the cords
text.normalized: The righteous LORD did cut the cords
text.reading: The righteous LORD did cut the cords

text.diplomatic: of the ungodly crew.
text.normalized: Of the ungodly crew.
text.reading: of the ungodly crew.

text.diplomatic: Let Zion’s haters all be turned
text.normalized: Let Zion’s haters all be turned
text.reading: Let Zion’s haters all be turned

text.diplomatic: back with confüsion.
text.normalized: Back with confüsion.
text.reading: back with confüsion.

text.diplomatic: As grass on houses’ tops be they,
text.normalized: As grass on houses’ tops be they,
text.reading: As grass on houses’ tops be they,

text.diplomatic: which fades ere it be grown:
text.normalized: Which fades ere it be grown:
text.reading: which fades ere it be grown:

text.diplomatic: Whereof enough to fill his hand
text.normalized: Whereof enough to fill his hand
text.reading: Whereof enough to fill his hand

text.diplomatic: the mower cannot find;
text.normalized: The mower cannot find;
text.reading: the mower cannot find;

text.diplomatic: Nor can the man his bosom fill,
text.normalized: Nor can the man his bosom fill,
text.reading: Nor can the man his bosom fill,

text.diplomatic: whose work is sheaves to bind.
text.normalized: Whose work is sheaves to bind.
text.reading: whose work is sheaves to bind.

text.diplomatic: Neither say they who do go by,
text.normalized: Neither say they who do go by,
text.reading: Neither say they who do go by,

text.diplomatic: GOD’s blessing on you rest:
text.normalized: GOD’s blessing on you rest:
text.reading: GOD’s blessing on you rest:

text.diplomatic: We in the name of God the LORD
text.normalized: We in the name of God the LORD
text.reading: We in the name of God the LORD

text.diplomatic: do wish you to be blessed.
text.normalized: Do wish you to be blessed.
text.reading: do wish you to be blessed.
